inputs.52.text: 2D anime illustration with soft cel shading, clean thin dark-brown line art, gentle painterly gradients. Full-body character reference of a young woman in her early twenties standing straight and facing the viewer, arms relaxed at her sides. Shoulder-length straight black hair, the ends slightly damp and separated into strands, a few strands across her forehead. Calm dark-brown eyes, a small closed mouth, pale skin. She wears a navy duffle coat reaching mid-thigh with cream toggle buttons and an upturned hood, over a cream cable-knit sweater whose collar shows at the neck, a charcoal pleated skirt, black tights and brown leather loafers. Plain off-white background, even soft studio light, the figure centred and filling the height of the frame.
